description:
Windows port of Easydict - Dictionary and translation app

Windows port of Easydict translation app. Supports 15+ translation services (Google, DeepL, OpenAI, Gemini, etc.), global hotkeys, multiple window modes, clipboard monitoring, and LLM streaming. Self-contained application with system tray support.
What's Changed
- Add OrcaRouter PKCE sign-in with loopback callback listener by @xiaocang in #206
- fix(i18n): restore language-detection warning translations (#209) by @xiaocang in #211
- Add OCR image upscaling for improved small text recognition by @xiaocang in #214
- fix: keep user-level Claude Code settings and surface real CLI errors by @xiaocang in #210
- feat: text actions, selection action strip and plugin-ready service foundation by @xiaocang in #212
- Add hover word lookup feature by @xiaocang in #215
- Fix phonetic display for bidirectional English translations by @xiaocang in #220
- Make pop button timing configurable and improve responsiveness by @xiaocang in #219
- Refactor OCR upscaling to shared library for worker/UI parity by @xiaocang in #221
- Detect and report proxy connection failures separately by @xiaocang in #228
Full Changelog: v0.9.2...v0.9.3
